# OIDC sign-in validates its configuration before it touches the output,
# listens, opens a browser or contacts a provider, and never echoes flag
# values. Output publication is tested in oidc_output_test.go.

skygo oidc login --help
stdout 'authorization-endpoint'
stdout 'token-endpoint'
! stdout 'password'

# Every endpoint is explicit; nothing is discovered from the issuer.
! skygo oidc login --issuer https://idp.example --client-id skygo --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token
stderr 'required flag\(s\) "authorization-endpoint" not set'
! exists id.token

! skygo oidc login --issuer http://idp.example --client-id skygo --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token
stderr 'issuer must be an HTTPS URL'

! skygo oidc login --issuer https://idp.example/?RECOGNIZABLE_SECRET --client-id skygo --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token
stderr 'issuer must be an HTTPS URL'
! stderr 'RECOGNIZABLE_SECRET'

! skygo oidc login --issuer https://idp.example --client-id 'RECOGNIZABLE SECRET' --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token
stderr 'client ID must be printable ASCII'
! stderr 'RECOGNIZABLE'

# The redirect is always the exact loopback callback; a configured endpoint
# cannot supply its own redirect or state.
! skygo oidc login --issuer https://idp.example --client-id skygo --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth?redirect_uri=https://evil.example --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token
stderr 'authorization endpoint must not set redirect_uri'

! skygo oidc login --issuer https://idp.example --client-id skygo --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth --token-endpoint http://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token
stderr 'token endpoint: must be an HTTPS URL'

! skygo oidc login --issuer https://idp.example --client-id skygo --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token --login-timeout 16m
stderr 'login timeout must be positive and at most 15m'

! skygo oidc login --issuer https://idp.example --client-id skygo --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token --redirect-port 70000
stderr 'redirect port must be between 0 and 65535'
! exists id.token

# Obtaining a credential does not try to load an older API credential.
env SKYGO_TOKEN=ambient-token
! skygo --token-file $WORK/missing --timeout 0s oidc login --issuer http://idp.example --client-id skygo --authorization-endpoint https://idp.example/auth --token-endpoint https://idp.example/token --output $WORK/id.token
stderr 'issuer must be an HTTPS URL'
! stderr 'choose only one credential'
! stderr 'token file must'
! exists id.token
